notes: The page begins with the fragment phisme évident, states the surjectivity of a tame fundamental-group homomorphism, and gives the document’s proof using generic connectedness, relative purity and specialization. It then begins Remarque 7 on Lefschetz pencils. These are document claims, not independently verified theorems.

No internet, OCR, recognition library, PDF extraction, other page, other reader, or additional agent was used. The supplied notation snapshot was read as instructed but never treated as authority over this page’s ink.

Whole image and each original half were viewed exactly once. Sixteen genuine local openings were cropped once each with LANCZOS and autocontrast; each crop was viewed once, no re-opening or re-cropping. c01 and c14 settled possible decoration/overprint questions without a witness difference.

Line labels L1–L27 count the opening fragment as L1, the homomorphism display as L2, the proof beginning as L5, the remark heading as L26, and its final line as L27. Interlinear additions are described relative to these physical base lines.

All ten explicit C doubt items and all five apparent-slip items are individually accounted for in c_doubts. Duplicate g/v concerns point to the same inspected ink. The prospective reference figure(ra) is not treated as a written admission of an unverified proof step.

The mixed U/V variable was not forced to V from the covering-space context; the g/v, men/mem and m/nt cells were not resolved by expected spelling or mathematical grammar. The greater-or-equal change concerns the slant of the lower stroke only and changes no relation.

Insertion un voisinage ouvert assez petit T de is anchored before la grassmanienne; neither dans nor a barred t is present. The addition by compte is retained near its immediate spatial position, with its anchor explicitly unresolved.

Cancelled tel que sa, de, V de Y, f and connu have readable remnants. The cancelled final famille is clipped after visible famill, so no invisible e is supplied. The last cancelled word is par and its trailing mark is a pen downturn, not a typed hyphen.

Literal surprises retained include enx vertu, grassmanienne, grave over m in croise-m-ents, figure(ra), and Remarque7.Avec without blank cells. Two low points before t prime are kept in an inline drawing with uncertainty about their purpose.

One single underline is beneath surjectif and another beneath Remarque only. H’s heading-emphasis macro choices are not counted as separate discrepancies; actual numeral/period spacing is counted. The absence of a handwritten identity wrapper alone is also not counted.

There is no manuscript/typed page number, date or stated total page count on this page. The bottom-left 114 is an archive sheet number. SGA 1 XIII, SGA 7 XVIII, corollary 3, the reference to 6 and Remarque 7 are text references, not dates or pagination.

Pale background show-through and page-edge noise were not treated as additional front-side prose. No stamp or independent mathematical diagram is present. The margin stroke and isolated point cluster are represented graphically without attributing purpose or material.
No mathematical proof verification was performed in this reader run. File/schema validation is editorial validation and is not entered in checks.

Editorial validation actually performed: report fields and enumerations, whole-image bbox bounds, 19 unique recorded image paths, all 16 crop paths, 15 C-question/slip entries, transcription TeX brace balance, and absence of unsupported witness-state macros. No TeX compilation or mathematical verification was claimed.
